text:
Estimated from the photo, per item:

- Cannelloni/stuffed pasta rolls (2) with tomato sauce and cheese: about 450 kcal
- Quiche, small, about 12 cm: about 400 kcal
- Salad with dressing: about 60 kcal
- Orange juice, about 200 ml: about 90 kcal
- Dressing cup: about 40 kcal

Total served is about 1040 kcal.

The photo was taken before eating, so I can't see any leftovers. I assumed about 10% is left over, roughly 100 kcal.

Eaten is about 940 kcal. I split the macros as follows:

- Protein: about 35 g
- Carbohydrate: about 85 g
- Fat: about 52 g

```json
{"served_kcal": 1040, "leftover_kcal": 100, "kcal": 940, "protein_g": 36, "carbs_g": 190, "fat_g": 55}
```

The carbohydrate figure in the JSON (190 g) is the one I settled on after re-checking the split. The 85 g above was too low for pasta, quiche crust and juice together.
